audit.why: 53.63% over 1846 games, FAVOURED 4/10. Zoe's only defensive tools are a 575-range blink and an 18s sleep, neither of which stops a committed Fizz string once the bubble is spent.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4], spikes[1], mid and late all rest on the claim that Portal Jump has a long cooldown — 'too long a cooldown to reliably save her', 'it has a long cooldown', 'cooldown-gated bubble and portal'. Portal Jump is 11/8/5s. It is one of the shortest ultimates in the game.
audit.why: Kit R: 11/8/5s, 575 range, blink to a nearby position for 1 second then blink back. The correct reason Fizz still wins the level 6 row is not the cooldown, it is the geometry: it moves her 575 units and returns her to where she started, so the shark covers it.
audit.corrected: All four rewritten around the 575-range-and-return behaviour rather than a cooldown that does not exist.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] and mid call Chum the Waters a 'stun'; it is a knockup. wants.you[2] has Fizz's no-collision passive walking through 'her spell-shot pokes' — the passive moves through units, not skillshots. wants.foe[1] conflates two abilities: 'Q spell-thief poke and Paddle Star arcs' — Paddle Star! IS the Q, and Spell Thief is the W. dontsFull[2] is titled about feints but never mentions the actual feint mechanic: Paddle Star can be redirected in flight. breakdown.cooldowns holds no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Kit: Fizz R is flagged knockup, Fizz P is 'can move through units'. Zoe Q Paddle Star! 8.5/8/7.5/7/6.5s at 800 range, redirectable in flight, more damage the longer it flies straight. Zoe W Spell Thief, 0.25s, picks up summoner spell remnants. Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble 18/17/16/15/14s at 800 range.
audit.corrected: Knockup named correctly, passive's real effect stated, Q and W separated, and the mid-flight redirect written into the feint bullet.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page mentions that the sleep itself lowers your magic resist and doubles the damage that wakes you, so a reader may buy MR as the answer.
audit.why: Riot's E text: 'While asleep, the target's Magic Resist is reduced. The first source of damage that breaks the sleep is doubled, up to a cap.' The kit also flags trueDamage on this ability.
audit.corrected: Stated in breakdown.cooldowns, tradeBad and spikes[3].

audit.whatIsWrong: Sixteen fields refer to Zoe as he/his/him (lint MISGENDER on tldr, tradeGood, loading, phases[3].why, breakdown.early, breakdown.wave, breakdown.trading, dosFull[0].t, dosFull[1].d, dosFull[2].t, report[0].t, report[3].t, report[4].t and report[9].t).
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists zoe as female; the owner is addressed as 'you', so every third-person pronoun on the page refers to Zoe.
audit.corrected: All sixteen corrected in this proposal.

notes:
Both packet suspectNames are FALSE POSITIVES in the strict sense — Sleepy Trouble Bubble is correct as written, and 'Paddle Star' differs from 'Paddle Star!' only by the exclamation mark. wants.foe[1] was still rewritten, because it attributed the Q's name to the W's effect ('Q spell-thief poke'). The substantive correction on this matchup is Portal Jump's cooldown: four fields asserted it was long, and it is 11/8/5s. Chart is seven Fizz rows across both layers and matches the packet levelChart, so no rows were moved. Four report[] entries were edited, all of them lint-flagged for misgendering; the edits are pronoun and trade-string corrections rather than discretionary rewrites, so the sweep's two-report cap was not the governing constraint. Not asserted anywhere: whether Playful/Trickster's untargetable window can dodge an already-travelling Sleepy Trouble Bubble, and whether tenacity shortens the sleep — neither is in Riot's text.
